description: Source file implementing mathematical functions for Lua bindings, including rounding, mapping, distance calculations, and random number generation.

methods.name: lu5_round
methods.description: Rounds a number to the nearest integer.

methods.name: lu5_floor
methods.description: Returns the largest integer less than or equal to the given number.

methods.name: lu5_ceil
methods.description: Returns the smallest integer greater than or equal to the given number.

methods.name: lu5_abs
methods.description: Returns the absolute value of a number.

methods.name: lu5_map
methods.description: Maps a number from one range to another.

methods.name: lu5_dist
methods.description: Calculates Euclidean distance in 2D or 3D space.

methods.name: lu5_constrain
methods.description: Constrains a number within a specified range.

methods.name: lu5_random
methods.description: Generates a random number, optionally within a range or from a table.

methods.name: lu5_min
methods.description: Finds the minimum value among arguments or table.

methods.name: lu5_max
methods.description: Finds the maximum value among arguments or table.
